newsitem.title: USA: McDonald's Q1 U.S. same-store sales up.
newsitem.headline: McDonald's Q1 U.S. same-store sales up.

text.p: McDonald's Corp said Wednesday its U.S. same store sales for the first quarter showed an increase, although the company declined to specify the amount of the rise.
"Comparable sales in the United States were up very nicely" in the first quarter, Ed Rensi, president of the McDonald's USA division, said in a telephone interview.
The first quarter increase in U.S. same-store sales, measuring results from units open at least a year, follows six consecutive quarters of declines.
McDonald's had first given an indication of positive U.S. same store sales on February 25, when the company said year-to-date comparisons in the United States were stronger than a year ago.

One of the factors in the first quarter sales increase is its successful 101 Dalmatians movie tie-in for its Happy Meal for children. McDonald's called that promotion the most successful Happy Meal campaign in its history.
